name: 27871-decode-kimilinear48b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node (half the node).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine, no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: hybrid linear-attention MoE decoder (KimiLinearForCausalLM, 27 layers, 256 routed experts + 1 shared, 49.1B total and ~3B active per token), bf16, 98.2 GB over 20 shards -- ~24.6 GB per GPU at TP=4. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, no warmup and no cooldown, bounded at 32 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 27871.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, 100 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out per request (min == max on both), 32 requests -- one shape repeated, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from short prompts for 32 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The serve command this transcribes:
#   vllm serve moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct -tp 4 --trust-remote-code
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# The checkpoint ships its own config/modelling module and will not load without this.
trust-remote-code: true

# The checkpoint declares model_max_length 1048576; this workload's worst case is 100 + 1024,
# so 4096 clears it and keeps the block tables and per-request allocator bounds small.
max-model-len: 4096
dtype: bfloat16
